As a lens, single GLP "meta-neurons" are the strongest probes of discrete Swiss-Prot concepts at both hosts, beating InterPLM's released SAE features, and lead on continuous properties at 8M though not at 650M; falsification tests show this is mostly concentration, not new information. As an editing prior, the on-manifold correction makes DiffMean steering of three biochemical properties effective and restores on-manifoldness, but only in isolation: re-embedding the sequences actually produced after several rounds of decoding, the structural plausibility is compromised. This is mainly reproduced in additional SAE-based clamping structural steering experiments, where only Helix motif succeeds. The naturalness failure is traced to the rewriting coverage and the decoder rather than the prior, highlighting what the method must clear before it can serve for both discovery-by-editing and discovery-by-exploration. Trained GLPs are released on huggingface.co/collections/HPAI-BSC/glprot.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the Interpretability for Discovery (Interp4Discovery) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: 面向蛋白质语言模型解释与操控的生成式潜先验
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有大模型可解释方法多依赖强结构假设，本文把生成式潜先验(GLP)——直接在冻结模型激活上训练的扩散模型——迁移到 ESM-2 的激活(UniRef50)，在 8M 与 650M 两个规模上同时检验其作为蛋白质表征探测工具与激活编辑先验的效果。生成质量随深度与算力平滑提升;作为探测工具，单个 GLP「元神经元」在两个宿主上都是 Swiss-Prot 离散概念的最强探针，优于已发布的 InterPLM SAE 特征，但在 650M 上连续属性的优势消失，证伪实验表明其增益主要来自集中性而非新信息。作为编辑先验，流形内校正使 DiffMean 对三种生化属性的操控变得有效，但多轮解码后重新嵌入真实生成的序列，结构合理性仍被破坏，问题被追溯到重写覆盖度与解码器而非先验本身。工作为蛋白质语言模型的机制解释与可控生成划出了方法必须越过的门槛，GLP 权重已开源。
arxiv.reason: LLM 可解释与激活操控方法扎实，但落在蛋白质领域、且为 workshop 论文

arxiv.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
arxiv.abstract: Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.
arxiv.titleZh: 覆盖率的代价：为英国风电功率的原生预测不确定性做共形校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 风电功率预测的不确定性区间常用于备用容量与申报决策，却往往达不到名义覆盖率。研究在英国两座风电场、六种预测器（从 ARIMA 到表格基础模型）上对原生预测区间施加共形预测，考察其增益与代价。结果显示，校准可修复经验边际覆盖率且几乎不损失 Winkler 分数，但这一表面成功掩盖了大风工况下的覆盖不足；按预测风况分区校准可把边际覆盖转为工况级覆盖，使日前大风场景的越界电量相对池化校准下降逾 40%，同时整体区间更窄。
arxiv.reason: 风电预测的共形校准，属能源垂直应用，与 LLM 无关

arxiv.title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
arxiv.abstract: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.
arxiv.titleZh: 双层对话记忆中的压缩、衰减与强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 对话智能体需要决定记忆中保留什么：是保留完整对话记录再做检索（RAG），还是把每轮压缩成原子事实后再检索。在 LoCoMo 上让两条路径在同一窗口回答全部 1,985 个问题，共用同一存储、同一生成器与评判器，并对 512 个答案不一致的题目做 McNemar 精确检验：压缩在四个可比类别上以 71.4% 对 64.6% 领先 6.8 点（p=5.5e-08），提示词 token 少 34%，但纳入对抗集后优势缩至 2.0 且不再显著。领先幅度随参考答案对原文措辞依赖的增加，从 +9.6 点变为 -3.1 点，说明压缩保留事实断言、丢弃表述方式；另报告四项负结果及功效计算。

arxiv.title: Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: Graph similarity computation is an important task in graph mining with many real-world applications, such as chemical compound analysis, program dependence comparison, and social network analysis. The problem is computationally challenging: Graph Edit Distance (GED) and Maximum Common Subgraph (MCS), which quantify the distance between graphs and identify their largest shared subgraph, respectively, are NP-hard to compute exactly. To address these computational challenges, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been applied to this problem. However, existing GNN-based approaches have primarily focused on small-scale graph datasets, while scalability to larger scales remains underexplored. In this work, we propose FiLSim, a scalable GNN-based framework, and investigate whether a simplified GNN pipeline can maintain competitive performance on standard benchmarks while scaling to large graphs. We additionally propose a sequential graph-editing strategy to construct large-scale graph datasets with reliable GED labels to evaluate scalability. The proposed framework is evaluated on four benchmark datasets and four newly created large-scale datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalability. FiLSim remains accurate on graphs with more than 150{,}000 nodes, where the baseline methods run out of memory or fail to learn, and scores all test pairs within seconds on a single GPU.
arxiv.titleZh: 用图神经网络扩展图相似度学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 图相似度计算中的 GED 与 MCS 均为 NP-hard，现有基于 GNN 的方法多在小图上验证，大规模可扩展性尚未被系统考察。FiLSim 提出简化的 GNN 流水线，并设计序列图编辑策略，自动构造带可靠 GED 标签的大规模图数据集，用于检验可扩展性。在 4 个标准基准与 4 个新建大规模数据集上，该方法在超过 15 万节点的图上仍保持准确，基线则出现显存溢出或无法学习，且单卡可在秒级完成全部测试对的打分。该工作为大规模图检索、程序依赖比较等场景提供了可落地的相似度计算方案。

arxiv.title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.

arxiv.titleZh: 当指令文件过时：编码 Agent 中的文档债与隐藏成本
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码 Agent 依赖 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 等仓库指令文件，当文件随代码演进变旧，便形成“文档债”，其成本在每次会话中重复支付，而只看任务成功率的评测会掩盖它。研究从三个活跃开源仓库中各取一条真实过时指令（测试命令、代码位置、组件添加流程），在固定代码与任务后，让 Agent 在保持过时、修正、删除三种版本下完成 22 个维护任务，并逐次工具调用分析两个模型共 732 条轨迹。Agent 在指令与任务相关时会遵循过时指引，即使别处有正确信息；过时测试命令使 Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次约多花两次工具调用，比修正版多三分之一，其余两例未检出差异；Agent 多能从即时失败恢复，却无一修复指令文件本身。

arxiv.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model
arxiv.abstract: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.
arxiv.titleZh: Maya a1：是选项读取模型，还是位置决定答案？非自回归决策模型中的顺序敏感性
arxiv.summaryZh: Laya/Maya a1在一次前向中按每个选项的[MASK]隐藏状态打分回答多选题；该工作重工程421M参数检查点，在951道Qwen验证题上做选项全循环轮换或随机置换，检验答案是否随位置改变。结果显示25.8%的题答案翻转（英语题19.7%），金标选项置首与置尾的准确率相差10.1个百分点，翻转集中于低置信度区间（54%对8%）。用2818条教师验证数据加选项打乱微调可将翻转率降至7.2%（不打乱为11.4%），置信度加权投票为69.7%而单次为69.1%但需4.1倍算力；说明选项顺序是此类模型稳健性与评测可靠性的关键变量。
arxiv.reason: 选项顺序偏差与评测可靠性相关，但模型小、非核心方向

arxiv.title: Test-Time Compute Scales Better with Parallel Agent Teams
arxiv.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the performance of a fixed model by spending more computation at inference. There are two common ways to spend it on agents when a verifier can score every attempt. Best-of-N sampling runs many independent agents and keeps the best result but saturates quickly. One large team of collaborating agents can score higher but stops improving as it grows. Can we get the best of both? Our method, parallel agent teams, does so by sampling many small teams in parallel and keeping the best team's result. We test it on 12 long-horizon tasks from GPU kernels and formal proofs to exploit development. With a 27B model and a budget of 100 agents, parallel teams of ten beat parallel agents on 10 of 12 tasks and beat one team of 100 on all four tasks where we ran such large teams. At equal dollar cost the same parallel teams beat a frontier model on half the tasks. A simple statistical model shows that individual agents lose because their many samples have a low mean and that one large team loses because a single sample gets no gain from variance. Sampling many small teams in parallel balances a high mean with the gain from variance. Parallel agent teams thus offer a more effective way to scale test-time compute.
arxiv.titleZh: 并行 Agent 团队让测试时计算扩展得更好
arxiv.summaryZh: 在验证器可打分的前提下，测试时扩展的两种常见做法各有瓶颈：Best-of-N 采样很快饱和，单个大型协作团队则随规模增长停止提升。方法改为并行采样多个小型团队并保留最优团队结果，在 GPU kernel、形式化证明、漏洞利用开发等 12 个长程任务上验证：27B 模型、100 个 Agent 预算下，10 人并行团队在 12 个任务中 10 个优于独立并行采样，在 4 个大团队任务上全部优于单个 100 人团队；同等美元成本下，有一半任务超过前沿模型。统计模型解释为小团队兼顾高均值与方差收益，为大模型 Agent 的推理算力分配提供了可操作的扩展方式。
arxiv.reason: 并行 Agent 团队的测试时扩展方法，直击 Agent 与推理扩展方向

arxiv.title: Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
arxiv.abstract: Current evaluations of agentic AI systems primarily rely on benchmarks. However, the static nature of benchmarks makes them uninformative about the value of auditing interventions at deployment time. For reliable deployment, we often need to determine within an agent's trajectory whether or not to intervene, e.g., by verifying the agent's current output or steering it toward different behavior, using either human review or more costly models or time-consuming agentic supervision. The value of such interventions is fundamentally a causal inference question, asking whether the causal effect of such an intervention is beneficial for the final outcome. Estimating this causal effect is particularly challenging due to the dynamic nature of the problem: the impact of an intervention depends on the current context and environment, as well as the agent's future behavior. We develop the first methodologically grounded framework for evaluating the causal effects of randomized interventions within agent trajectories. By leveraging a relatively small dataset of agent trajectories collected under randomized interventions such as verification or screening, we can estimate the dynamic causal effect of a rich class of (contextual) intervention policies. The structural parameters that we estimate can also be used to construct safety leaderboards that capture the risk of various agentic actions, which can be used by practitioners for audit prioritization. Applying our methods to tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox, and ImpossibleBench, we find that intervention effects vary substantially across agent actions and states. More broadly, our work suggests a rich research agenda at the intersection of causal inference and agentic evaluation, which we believe is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of AI agents in the real world.
arxiv.titleZh: 知道何时介入:AI 智能体的因果评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 静态benchmark无法回答部署时是否值得对智能体轨迹施加审计干预(验证输出、引导行为)，而这种干预的价值本质是因果问题:干预对最终结果的因果效应是否为正。为此提出首个方法学上完整的框架，仅用少量在随机干预下采集的轨迹数据，估计一类上下文相关干预策略的动态因果效应，并给出可复用的结构参数。在tau-bench Retail、ToolSandbox、ImpossibleBench上的结果显示，干预效应随智能体动作与状态差异显著。估计出的结构参数还能构建安全性排行榜、刻画各类agentic动作的风险，供实践者确定审计优先级。
arxiv.reason: Agent部署期干预的因果评估框架，评测方法学命中关注方向

arxiv.title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
arxiv.abstract: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.
arxiv.titleZh: 评估检索增强生成对算法问题求解的影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 竞赛编程题目同时要求代码生成与算法推理能力，为此构建了基于嵌入检索与相似度搜索的 RAG 流程，从知识库中检索同类题目，并用动态调整的阈值抑制检索噪声。在 CodeContests 上对比三种设置：仅给原始题面、拼接训练集随机样例、拼接检索到的相似样例，同时引入 Min-K 成员推断，分析生成代码是否受预训练记忆影响，以区分真实泛化与隐式召回。结果显示基于相似性的检索显著提升了 pass 率与题目对应的 CodeForces Elo 分数，为算法题场景下的代码生成提供了可扩展框架。
arxiv.reason: RAG 用于竞赛编程代码生成，方向相关但偏增量评估

arxiv.title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation
arxiv.abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.
arxiv.titleZh: 这些程序员够熟了吗?评估 LLM 在翻译中如何处理词汇知识冲突
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对外部词汇资源与模型固有多义词知识相冲突的问题，构造受控的汉译英任务:为熟悉的源词在语义类别内及跨类别赋予新含义作为上下文知识(CK)，系统评估词频、句子语境与提示框架对译文的影响。九个模型中，低频词以及支持所给含义的语境下 CK 依赖更强;提示框架可降低依赖，但九模型中有七个即便被明确要求忽略所给含义仍偏向 CK，同族中更大模型更倾向使用 CK。三组后续实验显示情态弱化降低依赖、重复效应取决于提示布局、推理效应因模型而异，为检测词汇冲突与引导 LLM 选词提供评估基础。

arxiv.title: Quasipolynomial-Time Planning for Decodable POMDPs
arxiv.abstract: We study planning for finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) with finite state, action, and observation spaces. Both exact and approximate planning are known to be computationally hard in this setting, so prior work has explored natural assumptions that make planning easier. Recent work [Golowich et al., 2022] gave quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for observable POMDPs. These are POMDPs whose observation channels satisfy an $\ell_1$-observability condition, but notably, no assumptions are required on the transition dynamics. In a similar vein, for every fixed $ρ>0$, we give quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for $ρ$-decodable POMDPs. We show that decodability is implied by both $\ell_1$- and $\ell_2$-observability and is strictly weaker than observability. Moreover, we show that the optimal decodability constant can be computed in polynomial time, whereas computing the optimal $\ell_1$-observability constant is NP-hard in the worst case. We also show that the fast filter-forgetting guarantee underlying the approach of [Golowich et al., 2022] does not extend directly from $\ell_1$-observability to constant $\ell_2$-observability. Thus, decodability is an easy-to-check, unifying assumption under which quasipolynomial-time approximate planning for POMDPs is possible.
arxiv.titleZh: 可解码 POMDP 的拟多项式时间规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 有限视野 POMDP 的精确与近似规划在最坏情况下计算困难，已有工作依靠 ℓ1-可观测性等假设获得拟多项式时间近似算法。本文提出 ρ-可解码性假设，证明 ℓ1-与 ℓ2-可观测性都蕴含可解码性，且可解码性严格更弱；最优可解码常数可在多项式时间内计算，而最优 ℓ1-可观测常数的最坏情形计算是 NP-hard。对任意固定 ρ>0，给出拟多项式时间的近似规划算法，并指出 Golowich 等人 2022 年依赖的快速滤波遗忘保证无法从 ℓ1-可观测性直接推广到常数 ℓ2-可观测性。
arxiv.reason: POMDP 规划复杂性理论，与 LLM 后训练／Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over $1,000$ sequential updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE.
arxiv.titleZh: ROSE：面向多模态大模型终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态大模型终身知识编辑中的局部性侵蚀与灾难性遗忘问题，将参数更新约束在已编辑子空间的正交补内，并引入动态计算的风险掩码保护对模型稳定性关键的事实参数子空间；推理阶段采用原型锚定语义门控与扰动驱动子空间融合的多粒度知识集成策略，仅在相关查询上激活编辑知识，抑制对无关输入的干扰。在两个主流多模态基准的五项指标上与SOTA方法相当，且在1000次连续编辑后仍保持稳定。为多模态模型持续事实更新提供了可复用的框架。
arxiv.reason: 多模态LLM知识编辑，属后训练周边扎实工作，非核心范式突破

arxiv.title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
arxiv.titleZh: 语言作为特质，礼貌作为策略：LLM社交推理智能体中语言效应的受控测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察措辞繁简与礼貌程度变化是否会改变LLM智能体在社交推理游戏中的信任与行动。基于LURK Werewolf框架分离言语行为谓词与自然语言实现，仅改写实现并从检查点重放游戏日，与重采样对照比较，同时控制语言跨度与逐句礼貌策略。30局、4335次重放显示两种操纵均不改变信任，投票与夜间行动无效应通过多重比较校正，最大未校正投票变化约4个百分点；自然对局中88%的面子威胁言语均直接公开表达。结果表明LLM智能体对表层语言变化不敏感，并提供可重放的受控评估范式。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体社交推理中的语言效应受控评估，属Agent评测擦边，分量有限

arxiv.title: From PAC bounds on the generalization error to PAC bounds on the parameter estimation error
arxiv.abstract: Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) bounds on the generalization error (the difference between the empirical prediction error computed on the training data and its expectation) are an established tool in statistical machine learning, and there have been several extensions of these bounds to dynamical systems. In parallel, in recent years, there has been growing interest in finite-sample bounds for parameter estimation error in system identification. The latter bounds tend to be algorithm-specific, relying on reformulating the identification algorithm as a least-squares regression problem. This is in contrast to classical PAC bounds, which are algorithm-agnostic and can be applied to any identification algorithm based on minimizing a cost function involving the empirical loss. In this paper, we show how oracle bounds derived from PAC bounds can be used to derive finite-sample bounds for dynamical systems. As an illustration of this approach, we present finite-sample parameter-estimation bounds for linear and bilinear systems with bounded inputs and noise. These bounds apply to identification algorithms based on minimizing a regularized empirical loss function. The key ingredient is to establish an oracle inequality, i.e., an inequality between the true prediction error of the learned model and the minimum achievable true prediction error, and then use either the convexity of the true loss or system-theoretic properties of the loss function to derive bounds on the parameter estimation error. We also analyze the rates of the obtained bounds and compare them with those of classical asymptotic results.

arxiv.titleZh: 从泛化误差的 PAC 界到参数估计误差的 PAC 界

arxiv.title: A Tight Hierarchy for Chain of Thought
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for extending the computational capabilities of transformer-based models. A growing body of recent work has begun to uncover the fine-grained computational power of transformers augmented with CoT, as well as their connections to classical complexity theory. In this work, we advance this line of research by establishing the first hierarchy theorem for CoT-based computation. Our main result shows that for any reasonable resource bound $r(n) \geq n$ and any $\varepsilon > 0$, \[ \mathrm{CoT}(r(n)) \subsetneq \mathrm{CoT}(r(n)^{1+\varepsilon}), \] where $\mathrm{CoT}(r(n))$ denotes the class of decision problems solvable by transformers using $O(r(n))$ CoT reasoning steps on inputs of length $n$. Our result shows that increasing the number of CoT reasoning steps provably yields strictly greater computational power, establishing CoT steps as a fundamental resource in transformer-based computation. Unlike classical hierarchy theorems, which are typically proved via diagonalization, our approach leverages known coarse-grained simulations between CoT-augmented transformers and Turing machines in both directions. Building on these connections, we adapt the classical padding technique from complexity theory to this setting to obtain a tight hierarchy. A key technical contribution of our work is the implementation of padding within the transformer-based CoT model.

arxiv.title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
arxiv.abstract: The success of modern score-based generative models is largely driven by diffusion-based training, which learns a collection of time-indexed score fields corresponding to progressively noisier versions of the data distribution. While such models achieve impressive sample quality, leveraging them for sound probabilistic inference---particularly sampling from arbitrary conditionals of the model---remains challenging. This difficulty arises because conditioning information is only available for clean data and not for the higher noise levels required to generate exact conditional samples. In this paper, we introduce DIffusion-free SCOre matching (DISCO), a principled approach that sidesteps the need for time-dependent score fields altogether. Our method is based on an objective that, while reminiscent of diffusion-based training, estimates only a single score of the (slightly perturbed) data distribution, for which the exact conditional score is readily obtained. In experiments, DISCO is competitive with state-of-the-art diffusion models in terms of sample quality. More importantly, DISCO yields a more faithful representation of the underlying data distribution and---crucially---enables accurate sampling from arbitrary conditionals, outperforming standard heuristic samplers. This capability opens the door to principled and flexible probabilistic reasoning with score-based models.
arxiv.titleZh: 无扩散的分数匹配用于精确条件采样

arxiv.title: Continuous wavelet-based feature extraction for laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy classification of human plasma samples
arxiv.abstract: Extracting discriminative features from laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) spectra is important for the classification of complex biological samples. This study evaluates continuous wavelet transform (CWT)-based spectral peak extraction for distinguishing human plasma samples labeled as SARS-CoV-2-positive or negative. Plasma specimens from 181 individuals, comprising 53 positive samples and 128 negative controls, were deposited as 5 μL droplets on silicon substrates and dried before analysis. Spectra were acquired using a nanosecond Nd:YAG laser operating at 1064 nm, with 100 single-shot measurements collected per specimen and averaged after intensity-based outlier rejection. CWT-based peak detection was coupled with a support vector machine (SVM) classifier. The reported leave-one-out evaluation yielded an accuracy of 93.00%, sensitivity of 94.67%, and specificity of 91.61%; these estimates remain provisional pending reconciliation with specimen-level predictions. Features identified by the CWT pipeline included emission lines assigned to Ca II, K I, and N I. The workflow provides a basis for examining spectral features associated with the studied plasma groups. Independent validation and assessment of specimen, substrate, and acquisition-related variability are required to establish generalizability and diagnostic relevance.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于连续小波变换特征提取的人体血浆样本激光诱导击穿光谱分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对复杂生物样本的 LIBS 光谱分类，评估基于连续小波变换(CWT)的谱峰提取能否区分 SARS-CoV-2 阳性与阴性人体血浆。181 例血浆样本(53 例阳性、128 例阴性)以 5 μL 滴于硅基底干燥，用 1064 nm 纳秒 Nd:YAG 激光采集，每个样本 100 次单脉冲测量并经强度离群剔除后平均;CWT 峰检测与 SVM 分类器耦合，留一法评估得到准确率 93.00%、灵敏度 94.67%、特异度 91.61%，提取的特征对应 Ca II、K I 与 N I 发射线。该流程为考察两组血浆的光谱差异提供基础，但泛化性与诊断价值仍需独立验证及样本、基底与采集变异评估。

arxiv.title: Safety Is $Π_1$, Provability Is $Σ_1$: One Framework for the Hugging Face Breach and OpenAI's Mathematical Proofs
arxiv.abstract: OpenAI's agents breached Hugging Face in July 2026, and the same company released more than seven hundred AI-generated manuscripts of mathematical proofs in October 2026. The first event is read as a failure in security, while the second is read as a success in mathematics. We read both through the hybrid framework of our paper (Kim and Kang, 2026, arXiv:2611.01914), in which coding, proving, and learning from data are derivations by one and the same deductive mechanism, distinguished by the kinds of premises from which they are derived. Under this framework, the AI systems behind the two events ran the same loop, in which a statistical proposer produces candidate exploits or proofs and a deductive verifier settles each one by a derivation. What separates the events is the logical form of the statement wanted by each of the two domains, security and mathematics. The safety of a program is a $Π_1$ statement, for it says that no exploit exists, which is not assured by any finite list of tests that have been passed by the program. By contrast, the provability of a sentence is a $Σ_1$ statement, for it says that a proof exists, which is assured by a single instance, namely a proof that has been checked by the deductive verifier. The theorem behind both is Turing's Undecidability Theorem: the halting set is $Σ_1$ but not decidable, so its complement is $Π_1$ and not $Σ_1$, which is to say that membership has a finite witness but non-membership has none. We prove that attaching a statistical proposer to a deductive verifier does not change this undecidability result, however good the proposer is. We then discuss what does assure safety and where the residual risk goes.
arxiv.titleZh: 安全是 Π₁，可证性是 Σ₁:用一个框架解读 Hugging Face 入侵事件与 OpenAI 的数学证明

arxiv.title: What to Delegate, What to Preserve: Human Preferences for Agentic AI Across Everyday Life and Work
arxiv.abstract: AI agents can execute multi-step tasks on users' behalf, yet the boundaries of acceptable delegation remain unclear. We report a scenario-based survey of 289 U.S. adults with prior AI experience covering 45 use cases across nine life domains. Each respondent evaluated one scenario per domain, producing repeated measures of automation preference, trust, collaboration, AI leadership, privacy concern, and willingness to pay. Automation preferences varied substantially across domains. Generalized estimating equation models showed that greater trust in the AI agent, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference. In contrast, concerns that automation would reduce personal fulfillment predicted lower automation preference. Open-ended responses further revealed a preference for bounded autonomy, with participants often favoring substantial AI execution while retaining human involvement, oversight, or final authority. We argue that delegation is best understood as a configuration of execution, collaboration, leadership, and authority.

arxiv.title: One Run Is Not Enough: A Monte Carlo Protocol for Evaluating LLM Reliability on Data Science Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating data science workflows. Benchmarks such as DataSciBench (2026) and StatQA (2024) have advanced the evaluation of their capabilities across data science and statistical tasks. Assessing their reliability requires examining both the quality of their responses and their consistency across repeated runs, task types, and difficulty levels. With this aim, we introduce DS-QA, a benchmark comprising 100 data science and statistics questions drawn from UK university courses, spanning 16 datasets and three difficulty levels. We develop a three-layer evaluation framework that combines general response properties (runtime, verbosity and text similarity), coarse-grained metrics (accuracy, code executability and completeness), and task-specific metrics. We evaluate OpenAI models using a Monte Carlo protocol with 100 repeated runs. The results reveal substantial variability in responses to data visualisation and supervised learning tasks, particularly at medium and hard difficulty levels, highlighting the importance of evaluating consistency alongside response quality. We also find that an increase of 0.1 in the word verbosity ratio corresponds to an increase of about 0.013 in the token verbosity ratio.

arxiv.title: Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
arxiv.abstract: We propose a fixed-point acceleration method for optimization over probability measures, applicable to a variety of machine learning problems. We represent probability measures as pushforwards of a reference distribution through a neural network map and equip the parameter space with the induced pullback Wasserstein metric. This geometric structure allows natural gradient descent to be interpreted as a fixed-point iteration on a Riemannian manifold. We accelerate this iteration using Riemannian Anderson mixing method, which exploits historical residuals to capture approximate second-order information without forming Hessians. In the present parametric setting, the manifold is represented by Euclidean coordinates endowed with a point-dependent metric, simplifying retraction and vector transport. We evaluate the method on multimodal sampling, PDE-based inverse problems, aggregation dynamics, Bayesian logistic regression, and generative modeling. Across the tested tasks, Anderson mixing reduces the number of natural-gradient iterations and achieves competitive performance relative to SGD and Adam in terms of both loss-gradient evaluations and wall-clock time. These results suggest that fixed-point acceleration is an efficient tool for improving the computational efficiency of training on parametric Wasserstein methods.
arxiv.titleZh: 神经Wasserstein流形上的不动点加速

arxiv.title: FOSCAR: Accelerating Decode Attention over 2- and 4-Bit KV Caches through Affine Folding
arxiv.abstract: Large-language-model decode attention streams the key-value (KV) cache for every generated token. Packing that cache into 2-bit or 4-bit quantized integers reduces memory traffic but does not automatically translate into latency saving. Existing 2-bit fused kernels reach under 31%/15% of peak HBM throughput on H100/B200. Converting each value and applying its scale and offset before feeding Tensor Cores is a major bottleneck because instruction-issue throughput is scarce on modern GPUs. Instead of applying scale and offset to each KV value, FOSCAR uses affine folding to apply them to the other operand or the output of decode-attention matrix products, depending on the quantization scheme (token-wise or channel-wise). This reduces scale-and-offset operations by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving the dequantized attention output in exact arithmetic. FOSCAR also uses bit manipulation to feed KV operands to Tensor Cores efficiently, requiring only 1 and 0.19 ALU instructions per INT2 element on H100 and B200, respectively. Finally, FOSCAR builds warp-specialized GPU pipelines for Hopper (H100) and Blackwell (B200) using wgmma and tcgen05. On H100, FOSCAR INT2 and INT4 kernels achieve geo-mean speedups of $3.36\times$ and $2.83\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, and $2.03\times$ and $1.71\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8. On B200, the corresponding INT2 and INT4 speedups are $2.67\times$ and $2.30\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, $1.48\times$ and $1.28\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8, and $1.16\times$ and $1.00\times$ over TensorRT-LLM NVFP4. We integrate FOSCAR into SGLang to benchmark serving efficiency. On long-context serving workloads, FOSCAR increases peak aggregate throughput by up to 170% and 341% over 2-bit and 16-bit baselines, respectively. We open-source FOSCAR as a kernel library at https://github.com/FutureMLS-Lab/FOSCAR.
arxiv.titleZh: FOSCAR：通过仿射折叠加速 2-bit 与 4-bit KV Cache 的解码注意力

arxiv.title: Intent-Aware Caching for Efficient LLM Serving
arxiv.abstract: Modern LLM serving systems use prefix caching to accelerate multi-turn conversational workloads. They cache the key-value states of previous conversation prefixes and reuse them when subsequent requests share the same prefix, to avoid redundant prefill computation and reduce serving latency. However, achieving a high cache hit rate remains challenging because cache reuse depends on whether a conversation continues and how soon the next turn arrives. Our analysis of real workloads shows that user intent is a useful signal for this behavior, as different intents exhibit different continuation probabilities and inter-turn delays. Based on this key insight, we propose Intent-Aware Caching (IAC), an online eviction policy that classifies requests by intent, learns lightweight reuse statistics from recent serving logs and leverages these statistics to guide an oracle-inspired eviction strategy. Extensive evaluation on real workloads (WildChat and ShareChat) shows that IAC reaches a 34.6% cache hit rate. This substantially outperforms both the previous learning-based approach (18.8%) and traditional methods such as least recently used (LRU, 12.2%), while reducing average serving latency by up to 46.1%.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向高效LLM服务的意图感知缓存
arxiv.summaryZh: 前缀缓存的命中率取决于会话是否继续、下一轮何时到来，因此难以提升；对真实负载的分析显示，用户意图与续聊概率、轮次间隔强相关。IAC按意图对请求分类，从近期服务日志在线学习轻量复用统计，并以这些统计指导一种受oracle启发的淘汰策略。在WildChat与ShareChat真实负载上，缓存命中率达到34.6%，明显高于此前学习型方法（18.8%）与LRU（12.2%），平均服务延迟最多降低46.1%。

arxiv.title: ICare-DT: a digital twin for continuous forecasting of intensive care patients
arxiv.abstract: Digital twins of intensive care patients should update forecasts from new data and predict treatment responses, but few studies test whether routine records support either. We propose ICare-DT, a Transformer-based twin that updates a latent patient state hourly from new measurements without retraining. We trained it on 140,473 eICU-CRD stays to forecast vital signs crossing their training-set means. On test data, later forecasts beat the twin's own hour-6 forecasts of the same windows in all 12 settings (+0.073 to +0.153 AUROC). On validation data, controls that withheld or swapped the new hours traced the gain to the patient's own measurements. Without refitting, the model kept its gain on a second database (8 of 9 settings, +0.025 to +0.114 AUROC) in a prespecified evaluation of the previously analyzed MIMIC-IV test split. Refitted within MIMIC-IV, a twin state fine-tuned on clinical endpoints gave gradient boosting a significant gain for acute kidney injury (+0.0035 AUROC; hypotension +0.0010, not significant). To test response prediction, we built a benchmark that replaces the treatments in real records with simulated doses and injects responses of known size, visible only at measurement times. Ridge models supervised with injected effects recovered them from real records only through frequently measured variables (heart rate) read at their measurement times. We asked standard learners to predict these effects for a dosing regime no patient had received. No standard learner outperformed predicting zero effect at an out-of-support query. When told how the simulated responses were generated, a separate learner recovered the effects from the same records without seeing their true values (R2 0.30 to 0.40 at one effect size). Routine records support forecasts that improve with each patient's new data, and our benchmark is a testbed for models that learn how responses are generated.
arxiv.titleZh: ICare-DT:一个面向重症监护患者连续预测的数字孪生
arxiv.summaryZh: 重症监护数字孪生需要随着新数据更新预测，并能预测治疗反应，但常规病历能否支撑这两点仍缺少检验。ICare-DT 用 Transformer 在 140,473 条 eICU-CRD 记录上训练，每小时依据新测量更新隐患者状态而无需重新训练；较晚做出的预测在所有 12 种设置下都优于同一窗口在第 6 小时做出的预测（AUROC 提升 +0.073 至 +0.153），对照实验表明这一增益来自患者自身的测量数据，而迁移到 MIMIC-IV 且不重新拟合时，9 项设置中有 8 项保留增益。治疗反应评测把真实治疗替换成注入已知效应的模拟剂量，标准学习器在超出支持范围的给药方案上都没有超过直接预测零效应，而知晓生成机制的专用学习器能从记录中恢复效应（R² 0.30 至 0.40）。

arxiv.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
arxiv.abstract: RidgeFill shortens prefill by not computing most of a model's upper layers for the prompt. The lower layers run exactly up to a split; from the split layer's state a per-layer map predicts every later layer's input, and each late layer writes its cache from that prediction. The design follows YOCO and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where the projection is trained into the model. RidgeFill retrofits it onto models that were never trained for it: the map is a ridge regression fitted once in closed form from one pass over calibration text, the layer's own projections run unchanged, and a chosen set of rows, the last few thousand tokens, and every decoding step run the full model. Nothing is trained and no token is dropped. Most of the work was in measurement, finding a repeatable methodology. Loss averaged over all tokens hides RidgeFill's error. Needle retrieval in the filled region, loss on tokens that depend on distant context, and splice tests that swap filled keys or values for exact ones show which component carries it: the keys on Llama-3.1-8B, half of it in their scale, and the values and the recurrent state on Qwen3.5-9B. On Qwen3.8-27B in a llama.cpp fork on an A100, time to first token is 1.25 to 1.31x faster at 16K to 120K tokens with the maps in VRAM; RULER changes by -1.2 and -1.4 points and LongBench v2 by -1.4; the 95 % intervals include zero but do not rule out losses of a few points. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in vLLM it is 1.50 to 1.60x faster than exact at 9K to 32K tokens, with RULER's needle tasks at 99.8 against 100.0 and perplexity on novel tokens 2.65 % higher [-0.02 %, +4.93 %]. On three 8 to 9B reference models, at the same split and tail as the identity fill, the fitted map retrieves 49.1 and 49.6 more filled-region RULER points on the two dense models (at that split Llama's loss is worse), and its long-document loss is +/-0.03 nats of the released SwiftKV checkpoint's.
arxiv.comment: 50 pages, 15 figures, 38 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Approximate-Science/ridgefill-data
arxiv.titleZh: RidgeFill:面向更快预填充的免训练后层缓存填充
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长上下文预填充中上层计算开销大的问题:低层精确计算到切分层，用一次性闭式拟合的岭回归逐层映射，从切分层状态预测后续各层的输入，后层据此直接写入 KV cache，不训练也不丢 token;最后几千 token 与每个解码步仍走完整模型。测量上，该工作指出对全部 token 平均 loss 会掩盖误差，因此改用填充区 needle 检索、依赖远距离上下文的 token loss 以及 splice 测试来定位误差来源。在 A100 上的 llama.cpp 中，输入 16K–120K token 时首 token 时间加速 1.25–1.31x,RULER 下降 1.2–1.4 点;在 vLLM 中，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 在 9K–32K token 上加速 1.50–1.60x,needle 任务为 99.8 对 100.0。该工作可直接用于长上下文推理服务中的预填充延迟优化。
arxiv.reason: 免训练改造预填充阶段的 KV cache，长上下文推理加速且测量扎实

arxiv.title: Attend at the Right Resolution: Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention via Query-Key Interaction Structure
arxiv.abstract: Attention is a major scalability bottleneck in large language models (LLMs), with its computational cost and key-value (KV) memory traffic becoming increasingly prohibitive as context length grows. Sparse attention addresses this bottleneck by restricting each query to a subset of the context, but its effectiveness hinges on identifying relevant regions both cheaply and reliably. Existing training-free methods primarily rely on runtime relevance estimates, with selection dimensionality and granularity typically governed by fixed heuristics rather than the intrinsic interaction structure of pretrained attention heads. We take a different perspective: the query-key operator of each pretrained head defines a characteristic response structure that determines the resolution needed for sparse selection, both across feature directions and across context tokens. Building on this insight, we propose Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention (HASA), a training-free sparse attention framework that jointly adapts selection resolution along these two dimensions. Along the feature dimension, the singular spectrum of each head's query-key operator determines an effective rank, yielding a compact, head-specific response space. Along the sequence dimension, neighboring regions are progressively merged according to the directional coherence of their token responses in this same space, while heterogeneous regions remain separate. Exact attention is then computed using the original full-dimensional KV states of the selected regions. HASA captures 88.1% of dense-attention mass and, compared with UNIQUE, a strong recent sparse-attention baseline, improves accuracy by up to 3.47 and 2.57 points on RULER and LongBench-Pro, respectively, and accelerates self-attention by up to 1.32x, while achieving up to 14.07x speedup over dense attention.
arxiv.titleZh: 按需分配注意力分辨率：基于查询-键交互结构的头自适应稀疏注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 稀疏注意力需要在低成本下可靠定位与每个查询相关的上下文区域，而现有免训练方法多用固定启发式决定选择维度与粒度，忽略了预训练注意力头自身的交互结构。HASA从每个头的查询-键算子出发，沿特征维度用其奇异谱确定有效秩、构造头专属的紧凑响应空间，沿序列维度按该空间中 token 响应的方向一致性渐进合并相邻区域，再对选中区域用原始全维 KV 计算精确注意力。方法可捕获稠密注意力 88.1% 的质量，在 RULER 与 LongBench-Pro 上较 UNIQUE 分别提升至多 3.47 与 2.57 分，自注意力加速至多 1.32 倍，相对稠密注意力加速至多 14.07 倍。
arxiv.reason: 免训练头自适应稀疏注意力，直击长上下文效率瓶颈

arxiv.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
arxiv.abstract: LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. We test the tilt as a prediction for LLM-guided program search, committing each prediction from calibration data before the search runs. The level after 150 steps rises with the minibatch size in six of seven settings, but its predicted value fails: on bin packing, search attains 62-88% of the predicted gain when the proposer edits the parent and 109-119% when it writes new heuristics. The attained fraction falls with the parent-child quality correlation of unselected mutation; a registered test on two new settings confirmed the direction, but not the quantitative agreement after a correction. Further registered tests found that runs started from a good program kept losing quality over 300 steps, more so from starts that search had selected, by a margin that passed its registered rule narrowly. Runs from different starts had not reached a common level, so whether the tilt describes the stationary law of LLM editing remains open. A registered test in prompt optimisation on frozen task-model scores failed: search exceeded the tilt, and the bin-packing relation did not transfer.
arxiv.comment: 34 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered predictions, code and data checksums are described in Appendix C
arxiv.titleZh: 验证器噪声即温度:检验有限预算LLM引导搜索中的倾斜预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 将LLM引导搜索的keep-if-better接受门建模为可逆马尔可夫链:分数差为逻辑噪声且变异算子可逆时，稳态是变异平衡经exp(βf)倾斜，β=4F′(0)，小批量门控的β随批量平方根增长;缓存incumbent分数会虚高记录分数。在程序搜索上做预注册检验:150步后水平在7个设定中6个随批量升高，但数值不符，装箱任务仅达预测增益的62–88%(编辑父代)与109–119%(写新启发式)，达成比例随父子质量相关性下降;从优质程序出发300步持续掉质量，提示优化上的测试亦失败。为噪声—温度类比划出定量边界，对prompt优化器与搜索harness的门控设计有警示。
arxiv.reason: LLM引导搜索门控的理论检验，选题有趣但结论偏否定，分量有限

arxiv.title: The Multiscale Single-Index Model: An MSE Analysis of Online SGD Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: We consider the Multiscale Single-Index Model (MSIM), first introduced by Oymak and Soltanolkotabi (2021), as a stylized model for hierarchical feature learning with scale separation. Each layer extracts a shared single-index feature at one physical scale and passes it to the next, giving a tractable setting in which to study how deep architectures learn local multiscale representations. Under non-degeneracy and delocalization assumptions on the link function and planted features respectively, for the two hidden-layer case ($K=2$), we analyze joint online spherical SGD under MSE loss, which is a canonical regression objective, in discrete time and show that it achieves weak recovery from random initialization in $O(d\log^2 d)$ samples, followed by strong recovery to accuracy $\varepsilon$ in $O(d\log(1/\varepsilon))$ additional samples. The main technical challenge arises from the non-Gaussian learned features observed by the second layer. We address this challenge through a quantitative Gaussian comparison using delocalization, combined with sharp trajectory-level control of the coupled SGD dynamics. This work is a companion to Bruna (2026, arXiv:2607.03347), which studies recovery under a correlation objective for general $K$.
arxiv.titleZh: 多尺度单指标模型：在线SGD动力学的MSE分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究多尺度单指标模型（MSIM）中的分层特征学习，每一层在一个物理尺度上提取共享的单指标特征，并将其传给下一层。针对两层情形，在链接函数非退化、植入特征去局部化的假设下，分析离散时间下以MSE损失为目标的联合在线球面SGD，证明其从随机初始化出发，用O(d log²d)个样本实现弱恢复，再用O(d log(1/ε))个额外样本达到精度ε的强恢复。主要技术难点在于第二层观测到的非高斯学习特征；为此，借助去局部化做定量高斯比较，并对耦合SGD轨迹进行精细控制。
arxiv.reason: 神经网络特征学习理论，与LLM后训练/Agent无直接交集

arxiv.title: Online Causal Configuration for Networked Systems via Doubly Robust Steady-State Learning
arxiv.abstract: Measurement exploration reveals how interacting local controllers behave but can alter the steady-state regime a network operator seeks to optimize. Exploratory rewards may therefore fail to identify a configuration's no-exploration value: under full exploration, identical logged distributions can conceal different target values. Identification requires accounting for both action-law mismatch and shifts in the steady-state context distribution. We introduce CAUSAL-UCB, which selects configurations using optimistic bounds on target causal values. Its interference-aware clipped doubly robust evaluator produces predecision certificates separating statistical variation from calibrated identification, transport, and temporal-dependence errors. For any finite horizon and predetermined schedule of measurement-exploration rates $\{η_t\}$, we prove lower bounds of $Ω((1+\sum_tη_t)^{-1/2})$ on minimax inference error and $Ω(\sum_tη_t)$ on measurement-induced deployment loss in a stationary, potentially slow-mixing family. We bound regret under valid certificates and selected-information growth, and establish an anytime finite-sample certificate with a shared radius for estimation, selection, and reporting in a restricted known-local-interference model. In a high-mismatch benchmark with 24 paired seeds and 200 rounds, CAUSAL-UCB attains target regret of $1.732$ versus $6.326$ for certified IPS-UCB, with deployment gaps of $30.607$ and $23.217$, respectively. Independent-audit coverage tests and trace-driven semi-synthetic studies further assess certificate coverage and deployment trade-offs.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于双重稳健稳态学习的网络系统在线因果配置
arxiv.summaryZh: 测量探索能揭示局部控制器交互行为，却会改变运营商欲优化的稳态工况，使探索性奖励无法识别配置的无探索目标值——动作律失配与稳态上下文分布漂移同时存在时，相同日志分布可对应不同目标值。CAUSAL-UCB 用目标因果值的乐观界选择配置，其干扰感知裁剪双重稳健评估器给出决策前证书，把统计波动与识别、迁移、时间依赖误差分开校准。在 24 组配对种子、200 轮的强失配基准上，目标 regret 为 1.732，优于 certified IPS-UCB 的 6.326；理论上给出 minimax 推断误差与测量诱导部署损失的有限时域下界，并在有效证书下界定 regret。该工作面向在线配置与稳态优化场景，为带干扰的因果评估提供了可验证的决策保障。
arxiv.reason: 在线因果配置与 UCB 理论为主，与 LLM 后训练仅弱相关

arxiv.title: How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?
arxiv.abstract: How does using less conversational history change reader-token use and benchmark scores? We examine this question on 1,100 BEAM questions. We held the retrieval ranking and reader constant across five fixed passage budgets, and mean assigned scores rose as the passage budget grew. The score gain per additional token became smaller at the upper tested budgets. Answerable questions generally received higher scores with more context. Pooled abstention scores sometimes rose as the passage budget shrank. We also tested message retention in a controlled task with explicit conversational-state targets and compared retained user messages with token-matched recency. Qwen matched the full state more often for direct requirements when user messages were retained. Its full-state matching declined when answers depended on references to earlier offers. Mistral produced near-floor results across the retention conditions. A scoring audit leaves the correctness of BEAM answers unresolved. These experiments characterize the token and score consequences of the tested memory budgets. Reliable budget selection depends on retaining the evidence each question requires and validating the measure used to assess answer quality.
arxiv.titleZh: AI Agent 需要多少对话历史？
arxiv.summaryZh: 在1100个BEAM问题上固定检索排序与reader，比较五种passage预算对token消耗和得分的影响：平均得分随预算增加而上升，但高预算区间每token增益递减；可回答问题通常受益于更多上下文，汇总弃答得分有时随预算缩小而上升。另在带显式对话状态目标的控制任务中比较保留用户消息与token匹配的近期消息，Qwen在直接需求上更常匹配完整状态，但答案依赖早前提议引用时匹配率下降，Mistral在各条件下接近下限。评分审计未确认BEAM答案正确性，表明记忆预算选择取决于是否保留问题所需证据及评测度量是否有效。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆预算与评测，方向相关但以经验分析为主

arxiv.title: TensorMutation: Learning Weight-Space Mutations of Deep Learning Models on Neural Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Mutation testing for deep learning (DL) faces a cost-realism trade-off. The pre-training approach produces realistic but computationally expensive mutants, whereas existing post-training operators modify trained models efficiently but produce mutants that less closely resemble real faults. This study asks whether the trade-off is necessary: can the weight-space effect of a fault-informed pre-training mutation operator be predicted from a trained model, without retraining it? We answer this question with TensorMutation, which represents a trained model as a neural graph and uses a mutation-conditioned graph neural network (GNN) to predict parameter changes. The GNN is trained offline and reused across unseen models so that TensorMutation can generate executable mutants without retraining. We construct a corpus of 25,252 original-mutant pairs from 71 multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifiers using 11 fault-informed pre-training operators, including 25 newly curated subjects. TensorMutation partially reproduces the behavioral effects of pre-training mutations on nine held-out subjects, and direct weight-space supervision significantly improves weight-space fidelity. On 12 real-fault subjects, TensorMutation achieves the highest median behavioral similarity among the evaluated approaches. The improvement over the post-training tool DeepMutation++ is statistically significant (Holm-adjusted p=0.018), whereas the differences from the pre-training tool DeepCrime and the norm-matched random control are not significant. These results show that fault-informed pre-training mutations leave learnable structure in weight space that transfers to unseen models.
arxiv.titleZh: TensorMutation：在神经图上学习深度学习模型的权重空间变异
arxiv.summaryZh: 深度学习变异测试长期受困于成本与真实性的权衡：预训练变异算子生成的变异体贴近真实故障，但需要重训练；后训练算子高效，却与真实故障偏差较大。TensorMutation将训练好的模型表示为神经图，用受变异条件约束的图神经网络直接预测参数改动，离线训练后可跨未见模型复用，无需重训练即可生成可执行变异体。基于71个MLP分类器与11个故障导向预训练算子构建25252对原始—变异体语料，在9个留出对象上部分复现了预训练变异的行为效应，权重空间监督显著提升权重保真度；在12个真实故障对象上取得最高中位行为相似度，相对DeepMutation++的提升统计显著（Holm校正p=0.018）。
arxiv.reason: 深度学习变异测试工作，与LLM后训练、Agent等主线无直接交集

arxiv.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
arxiv.abstract: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
arxiv.titleZh: 可操控的多目标群组相对偏好优化与联合训练的低秩适配器
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准后训练只为固定目标权重产出单一策略，无法随用户偏好变化调整取舍。LambdaMix 在冻结基座上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器，用同一偏好向量同时选择适配器混合比例、并对各自归一化后的奖励加权，从而以群组相对在线 RL 一次训练得到偏好条件化的策略族，推理时改偏好无需再优化。在四个模型上的有用性/无害性与「解数学题同时遵循指令」任务中，其超体积全面优于条件化与策略合并基线，且所需训练 completion 与存储的适配器参数均少于一组 GRPO 专家策略；固定架构与初始化时，同时变化适配器混合与目标权重比单独变化其一的得分范围更宽、覆盖更广。
arxiv.reason: 多目标偏好条件化后训练，LoRA混合加群组相对RL，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.
arxiv.titleZh: 在世界模型中以测试时基于模型的强化学习编码记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对世界模型强化学习在需要长期记忆与规划的任务上仍难超越人类的问题，跳出以架构设计增强记忆的常见思路，提出 TT-MBRL：在测试时用梯度下降把当前回合的观测记忆写入世界模型参数，使每个回合都得到一个专属世界模型，而非仅依赖上下文记忆。在 Memory Maze 的二维简化版上验证了跨不同世界模型架构的一致性提升，并在三维 Memory Maze 基准上取得新的 SOTA；在 DeepMind Control 与 Atari 100k 等非记忆类基准上性能同样保持稳定。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型强化学习，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: BiLoGo: Reducing the smoothing of localised responses in Transformer-based neural operators for sheet forming
arxiv.abstract: Trial-and-error FE simulation of sheet forming could be computationally expensive, neural-network-based learned simulators are used to accelerate design. These simulators should accurately capture localised responses, such as thinning around sharp radii or near ribs, which determine formability. Transformer-based neural operators propagate information efficiently across the mesh but tend to smooth such localised responses. This study develops BiLoGo, a Bipartite Local-Global learned simulator with an FE-guided design that connects local node-element message passing with a Transformer-based neural operator for long-range information exchange. BiLoGo has three modules: a bidirectional node-element GraphSAGE model that learns nodal-elemental coupling on a bipartite graph and predicts each quantity on its native FE entity without interpolation; a dual-stream Transformer-based neural operator that processes blank deformation and tool contact with separate token sets, preventing localised contact information from being averaged with the whole-blank state; and a fusion and element update module that combines global and local features via gated residual fusion and updates element features conditioned on element-node kinematics. Evaluated on a dome-shaped cold forming case and two corner-shaped hot stamping cases (one with ribs), BiLoGo achieves the lowest positional and threshold-based thinning errors on all three cases compared with single-level and hierarchical graph-based models and Transformer-based neural operators. Near the ribs, the smoothing index of predicted thinning increases from 0.41-0.56 for Transformer-based neural operators to 0.94 for BiLoGo-U. Compared with the hierarchical graph network CAtt-BiUGNN, BiLoGo-T reduces mean positional error by 15.5% on the Corner case and BiLoGo-U by 8.3% on the Corner+Rib case, with 66-69% less training memory.
arxiv.titleZh: BiLoGo：在板材成形的 Transformer 神经算子中减少局部响应的平滑化
arxiv.summaryZh: 板材成形的试错式有限元仿真代价高昂，学习型仿真器可加速设计，但基于 Transformer 的神经算子在跨网格传播信息时会把尖角减薄、筋部附近等决定成形性的局部响应抹平。BiLoGo 采用有限元引导的双边局部—全局设计：双向节点—单元 GraphSAGE 在二部图上学习节点与单元的耦合，并直接在各自有限元实体上预测、免去插值；双流 Transformer 神经算子以独立 token 集分别编码板料变形与模具接触，避免局部接触信息被整板状态平均；融合与单元更新模块用门控残差融合结合全局与局部特征，并按单元—节点运动学更新单元特征。在一个圆顶冷成形与两个转角热冲压（其一含筋）算例上，BiLoGo 的位置误差与阈值减薄误差均最低，筋附近减薄平滑指数由 Transformer 神经算子的 0.41–0.56 提升至 BiLoGo-U 的 0.94，相较分层图网络 CAtt-BiUGNN 位置误差在 Corner 上降低 15.5%、Corner+Rib 上降低 8.3%，训练显存减少 66–69%。
arxiv.reason: 板材成形有限元学习仿真，属物理/制造垂直应用，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: Know What You Need: Efficient Activation Checkpointing
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model training is increasingly constrained by memory capacity. Activation Checkpointing reduces activation memory by avoiding storing selected activations during the forward pass and rematerializing them during backpropagation, thereby trading memory savings for additional computation. Although this technique is essential for scaling model training, rematerialization can be prohibitively expensive, particularly for Transformer linear layers. Approximate computation could reduce this overhead, but conventional approaches either introduce errors that accumulate over the backward pass or fail to exploit information available from the initial forward pass. We introduce a novel approximate rematerialization method that can yield unbiased gradient estimates: using information collected during the initial forward pass, the method selectively recomputes only the most important layer components, either through greedy selection or randomized sketching. Ablation studies show that the resulting gradients closely match the exact gradients. When applied to feed-forward layers, attention layers, or both, our method can recompute only two-thirds of the layer components in a Llama-488M model, while increasing perplexity by just 1.7%, 1.2%, and 2.5%, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 知己所需:高效的激活检查点
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM训练受显存容量限制，激活检查点通过不保存部分前向激活、在反向传播时重计算来换取显存，但Transformer线性层的重计算开销过高。该工作提出近似重计算方案:利用首次前向传播中收集的信息，以贪心选择或随机素描的方式只重算最重要的层组件，并保证梯度估计无偏。消融显示所得梯度与精确梯度高度接近;在Llama-488M上仅重算三分之二的层组件，前馈层、注意力层与两者同时应用的困惑度增幅分别为1.7%、1.2%与2.5%。该方法可直接嵌入现有训练栈，降低激活检查点的实际计算代价。
arxiv.reason: 近似激活重计算，命中高效训练方向，梯度无偏且结果可信

arxiv.title: Not Your Diary, Just Your Topic: Grading the Wrong-User Control
arxiv.abstract: A common test of personalization replaces a user's history with someone else's and measures the drop in accuracy. But this swap also changes the topics in the history, so the drop may reflect topic mismatch. We examine this problem with a frozen language model on LaMP-2 news categorization, using histories from similar users and synthetic histories assembled from other users' articles. The user's own history improves accuracy by 2.3 percentage points over a model trained without history. Removing history only at evaluation makes this gain appear larger, at 4.8 points. Category labels alone reproduce 86% of the accuracy gap between the user's own history and a random user's history. With synthetic histories matched on labels and text similarity, the gap falls to 0.9 points. Across two user splits and three training seeds, the advantage over a similar user's history is 3.2 points for users seen during training and 0.65 points for unseen users, where the evidence for an advantage remains inconclusive. A small movie-tagging experiment with one training seed also finds no advantage over other users' histories. These findings show why personalization should be evaluated on unseen users, with histories of similar content and a model trained without history as comparisons. We also find that adding gated cross-attention improves on a prefix-only model under our training setup; whether this holds more broadly remains open.

arxiv.titleZh: 不是你的日记，只是你的话题：重新审视「错误用户」对照
arxiv.summaryZh: 个性化评测常把用户历史替换为他人历史并测准确率下降，但替换同时改变了话题，下降可能只反映话题错配。在冻结语言模型上用 LaMP-2 新闻分类，以相似用户历史与他人文章拼装的合成历史作对照：自身历史仅比无历史模型高 2.3 个百分点，若只在评测时移除历史，增益虚高到 4.8 个百分点。仅凭类别标签即可复现自身历史与随机用户历史间 86% 的准确率差距，标签与文本相似度对齐后差距降至 0.9 个百分点；三个训练种子下，见过用户相对相似用户历史的优势为 3.2 个百分点，未见用户仅 0.65 个百分点。据此建议个性化评测采用未见用户、内容相似历史与无历史模型作对照。
arxiv.reason: 个性化评测可靠性分析扎实，但为 workshop 短文且限单一基准

arxiv.title: Transformer-FSQ: Discrete Latents for Extreme KV-Cache Compression
arxiv.abstract: Private, personalised language models must run on local consumer devices, where large, frontier models cannot fit, and retaining long contexts is non-trivial. Sequential memory---the key-value (KV) cache---grows linearly with context length, quickly dwarfing the model itself: for Qwen3-1.7B-Base, 200,000 retained entries require 21 GiB, 6.6 times more than the model weights. Yet the KV-cache compression methods we measured fail beyond moderate compression ratios. We introduce Transformer-FSQ, addressing extreme KV-cache compression by replacing standard key and value projections with a finite scalar quantisation bottleneck. Our cache stores a packed vector of discrete integer codes per token, with no per-token quantisation metadata. Converting a pretrained transformer trains only these projections on 0.25 tokens per original parameter. We evaluate Transformer-FSQ against five baseline families on models from 0.6B to 8B parameters. On long-context retrieval (RULER), from 12$\times$ to 97.5$\times$ Transformer-FSQ is the most accurate method we evaluate, across scales. A fused Triton kernel decodes directly from the integer codes; with baselines given their authors' kernels where available, it decodes at $1.01\times$ (95% interval $0.98$--$1.05$) the throughput of native SDPA attention on the uncompressed Qwen3-8B-Base at $32\times$ and $1.54\times$ at $97.5\times$. Extreme KV-cache compression is therefore a practical way to extend how much context a fixed device can hold.
arxiv.titleZh: Transformer-FSQ：面向极限 KV-Cache 压缩的离散潜变量
arxiv.summaryZh: 长上下文推理时 KV cache 随上下文线性增长，在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上 20 万条缓存需 21 GiB，远超模型权重本身，而现有压缩方法在较高压缩比下精度明显失效。为此将标准 key/value 投影替换为有限标量量化瓶颈，每个 token 的缓存仅存一组打包的整数编码，不含逐 token 量化元数据；转换预训练模型时只训练这些投影，训练量为原参数量的 0.25 个 token。在 0.6B–8B 模型上与五类基线对比，RULER 长上下文检索在 12×–97.5× 压缩比下均为最准确方法，配套 fused Triton kernel 直接从整数编码解码，在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上 32× 压缩时吞吐为原生 SDPA 的 1.01×、97.5× 时为 1.54×。该工作把极限 KV cache 压缩做成可落地手段，提升固定设备可容纳的上下文长度。
arxiv.reason: KV cache 极限压缩新方法，兼有架构改动与高效 kernel

arxiv.title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
arxiv.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
arxiv.titleZh: RuACT:将失活评分细则回收为自适应评论家与教师
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于评分细则(rubric)的强化学习在组相对优化下，全员失败(不可达)或全员通过(饱和)的细则对所有采样回答给出相同结果，因而零学习信号——Qwen3-4B 医学训练中 60.88% 的查询-细则观测处于失活状态。RuACT 按两类失活各自缺失的监督分配角色:不可达细则作 Teacher，作为特权信息驱动奖励门控的 on-policy 自蒸馏(提示中直接陈述可把满足率从 1.13% 抬到 91.25%);饱和细则作 Critic，分解为共享父权重的子细则以区分当前回答的质量差异。在 Qwen3-4B 上四个医学与科学基准全面优于 GRPO、细则重加权与细则引导探索，1.7B 上取得最佳平均;不可达细则的无引导恢复率由 35.02% 升至 42.86%，子细则细化使独立 rollout 的奖励-质量对齐从 57.74% 提升到 60.77%。为开放式任务的 RLVR 提供了一种按需分配监督信号的通用后训练思路。
arxiv.reason: 失活 rubric 的自适应角色分配，直击 RLVR 后训练信号稀疏问题

arxiv.title: Coordinatewise Epsilon for Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise
arxiv.abstract: Adam estimates second moments coordinatewise, but typically adds the same scalar $\varepsilon$ to every denominator. We study how this shared $\varepsilon$ affects convergence when noise and curvature vary across coordinates. Under coordinatewise finite-$p$ noise moments, $p\in(1,2]$, choosing $\varepsilon_i$ from the noise and curvature bounds for each coordinate attains the heavy-tailed $\ell_1$-stationarity benchmark $O(T^{-\frac{p-1}{3p-2}})$, matching the known optimal time exponent for smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization. For $1<p<2$, Adam with a shared $\varepsilon_t$ admits a lower bound of order $Ω(T^{-\frac{p-1}{2p}})$. This lower bound holds for every predictable scalar choice of $η_t$, $β_{1,t}$, $β_{2,t}$, and $\varepsilon_t$, precluding a dimension-uniform benchmark rate for this class.
arxiv.titleZh: 重尾噪声下 Adam 的逐坐标 ε
arxiv.summaryZh: Adam 通常在所有坐标的分母上加同一个标量 ε，但噪声与曲率在坐标间并不一致。该工作研究共享 ε 对收敛的影响：在逐坐标有限 p 阶噪声矩（p∈(1,2]）下，按各坐标噪声与曲率界选取 ε_i，可达到重尾 ℓ1 平稳性基准 O(T^{-(p-1)/(3p-2)})，与光滑非凸随机优化的已知最优时间指数一致。而共享 ε_t 时，对任意可预测的 η_t、β_{1,t}、β_{2,t}、ε_t 标量选择存在 Ω(T^{-(p-1)/(2p)}) 下界，表明该类方法无法获得维度一致的基准速率。这为 Adam 的自适应 ε 设计提供了理论依据。
arxiv.reason: Adam 优化器理论分析，与预训练优化相关但偏理论
